title: A novel model of pre-pregnancy particulate matter exposure and house dust mite-induced maternal allergen-induced airway inflammation leading to altered maternal immune activation and increased neuroimmune responses in the offspring
title_zh: 孕前颗粒物暴露与家尘螨诱导的母体过敏性气道炎症模型：导致母体免疫激活改变及后代神经免疫反应升高
abstract: Abstract Maternal immune activation (MIA) through infection, toxic exposure, or chronic inflammatory disease has been linked with an increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in offspring, such as autism spectrum disorder (ASD) or schizophrenia. Previously we have shown that inducing maternal allergic asthma with ovalbumin increased pro-inflammatory cytokines during pregnancy and altered behaviors in offspring. Other studies have separately shown that particulate matter (PM) can exacerbate the effects of allergic asthma. In this study, we used house dust mite (HDM) to induce maternal allergen-induced airway inflammation combined with a pre-pregnancy exposure to PM to assess the possible combinatorial effects on maternal inflammation and offspring brain cytokine levels. BALB/c mice were treated preconception with either PBS, HDM or PM, and subsequently challenged with HDM or PBS on gestational days (GD) 12.5 and 15.5 to create 4 groups; PBS, PM, HDM and HDM + PM. Maternal serum, placental tissue, and fetal brains were collected on GD15.5. Offspring brains were collected at postnatal day (p) 15 to analyze for differences in cytokine levels across treatments. HDM and HDM + PM treated dams were found to have elevated levels of pro-inflammatory and T-helper (T H ) type 2 cytokines in the serum and increased inflammation in the lungs, consistent with an allergic response. In the placenta, increased T H 2 cytokines IL-4 and IL-5 were found in the HDM + PM offspring, consistent with the maternal serum data. Fetal brains had a decrease in MIP-2, MCP-1, and G-CSF in HDM and HDM + PM treatment groups. In the p15 hippocampus, HDM and HDM + PM groups showed increases in several pro-inflammatory cytokines but decreased regulatory cytokine IL-10, representing a skewed inflammatory immune profile. We also saw decreased microglial density and soma size in the HDM + PM group in the hippocampus. Altered cytokine profiles were additionally noted in the cortex and cerebellum of p15 offspring. Overall, these data show an increased pro-inflammatory response in the brains of offspring in response to maternal immune activation with HDM and PM.
abstract_zh: 摘要：母体免疫激活（MIA）通过感染、毒物暴露或慢性炎症疾病与后代神经发育障碍风险增加相关，如自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）或精神分裂症。此前我们已证明用卵白诱导母体过敏性哮喘可在孕期提高促炎细胞因子并改变后代行为。其他研究亦表明颗粒物（PM）可加剧过敏性哮喘的影响。本研究使用家尘螨（HDM）诱导母体过敏性气道炎症，并结合孕前PM暴露，评估其对母体炎症和后代脑细胞因子水平的可能协同效应。BALB/c小鼠在受孕前分别接受PBS、HDM或PM处理，随后在妊娠第12.5天和15.5天以HDM或PBS挑战，形成四组：PBS、PM、HDM和HDM+PM。母体血清、胎盘组织和胎儿脑在GD15.5时收集；后代脑在出生后第15天（p15）收集，分析不同处理组的细胞因子差异。HDM和HDM+PM处理的母鼠血清中促炎和T细胞辅助型2（Th2）细胞因子升高，肺部炎症增加，符合过敏反应。胎盘中HDM+PM后代的Th2细胞因子IL-4和IL-5升高，符合母体血清数据。胎儿脑中HDM和HDM+PM组的MIP-2、MCP-1和G-CSF下降。在p15海马中，HDM和HDM+PM组显示多种促炎细胞因子升高但调节细胞因子IL-10下降，呈现偏向炎症的免疫谱。我们还观察到HDM+PM组海马中小胶质细胞密度和细胞体大小下降。p15后代的皮质和小脑亦出现细胞因子谱改变。总体而言，这些数据表明母体通过HDM和PM诱导的免疫激活可在后代脑中引发更强的促炎反应。
